# CAO product-purpose instructions

Use the repository's [contributor product context](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) when changing the GUI or
user-facing documentation. This instruction file makes that guidance available to coding agents;
the human-readable source of truth is `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

Recheck the current code and guides when supported games or workflows change.
